semantic_audit.input: Only entry a0 is read; its full word is used as a byte offset within each four-byte row. No other incoming argument or stack slot is consumed.
semantic_audit.count: Signed 16-bit count is loaded from D_8014A108. A nonpositive count takes the zero-result exit without a table load. Positive counts visit all rows 0 through count-1.
semantic_audit.table: Signed bytes are loaded from D_80150E88 + 4*i + field. No array capacity or field bounds are inferred; the source declares unsized rows and adds no check.
semantic_audit.return_value: v1 starts at zero, becomes one whenever a selected byte is nonzero, and is copied to v0 in the return delay slot. It does not exit early after a hit.
semantic_audit.memory_effect: Read-only table scan; no stores. No helper, fabricated operation, extra argument, volatile access, uninitialized local or forced register is introduced.

direct_transfer_scan.limit: No direct caller was found; indirect callers and computed transfers are not excluded

semantic_audit.arcade_equivalent: Not established; nearby accepted func_800F7644 uses the same signed count and indexed scan on a different table
semantic_audit.field_precondition: The declared four-byte row uses valid field subscripts 0 through 3. No caller-based proof supports wider flat-storage indexing; no checks are introduced.

checks: single selected values distinguish active and inactive rows
other field bytes do not influence the selected field
all 256 occupancy patterns over eight rows and each field
